review: The phone is compact and easy to use. The camera takes good photos in normal lighting. The phone feels premium and is comfortable to hold.
The design is good and the phone is easy to handle. Performance is fine for basic everyday tasks, but newer apps can feel slow.
The battery does not last very long compared with newer phones. Performance can be slow when several apps are running.
Good build quality and comfortable size. The camera is decent, but battery life is a weakness.
